---
title: Add and remove
description: Edit sources.yml to add and remove episodes, and earmark.toml to change the settings.
---

Everything you do after setup is an edit to one file, `sources.yml`. Each
entry in it is one episode. Each commit to it starts a run that dictates the
new entries and removes the deleted ones.

## Add something

Edit `sources.yml` in the GitHub web editor (the pencil icon works on a phone
too), add a line, and commit:

```yaml
- https://example.com/an-article-i-meant-to-read
- files/attention-is-all-you-need.pdf
- source: https://example.com/a-long-read
  title: A better title
  voice: bf_emma
```

- A **URL** is fetched and dictated.
- A **document** (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, EPUB, HTML, Markdown) must be in the repo.
  Upload it into `files/` with **Add file → Upload files**. Then list it by its
  path, such as `files/paper.pdf`.
- An entry can also be a `source:` with its own `title`, `author`, `date`,
  `voice`, `speed` or `profile`. See the [`sources.yml`
  reference](../reference/configuration.qmd#sources.yml).

A run takes about half as long as the audio it makes, so a 25-minute article
takes about 12 minutes. The **Actions** tab shows its progress. When it is
done, pull to refresh in your podcast app.

## Remove something

Delete the entry's line and commit. The next run removes the episode, its MP3
and its text.

An entry is matched by its exact text. Editing an entry's `voice` therefore does
not dictate it again. To dictate an entry again, delete it, commit, then add it
back.

## Change the settings

The first run writes `earmark.toml` into the repo. Edit it in the web editor to
change the defaults for new episodes: the voice, the speed, the feed title, or
the cover image. [Settings](../settings/index.qmd) lists every setting you can
change, in `earmark.toml` or on one entry in `sources.yml`.

## Limits

- **Everything in a public repo is public.** This includes every file in
  `files/`. Only upload what you have the right to share. GitHub Pages on a
  private repo needs a paid plan.
- **One file cannot be larger than 100 MB.** At the default bitrate, that is
  about 3.4 hours of audio. Split a longer book, or lower `bitrate` in
  `earmark.toml`.
- **A Pages site stops at about 1 GB**, which is about 30 hours of audio. The
  run summary warns you after 800 MB. Delete old entries from `sources.yml` to
  stay below the limit.
